extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for every core container, as a list of `{name, value}` or `{name, valueFrom}`.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector for the core pod.

podLabels.description: Extra labels for the core pod.

priorityClassName.description: Priority class of the core pod.

dtss.description: Resources of the dtss (time-series) container. The one that needs memory: Sigma2 gives it 32 to 64 GiB.

rmd.description: Resources of the rmd (region model description) container.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Seconds the services get to stop after SIGTERM.

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for the drms container.

enabled.description: Create a PodDisruptionBudget for drms, so a node drain takes them one at a time.

maxUnavailable.description: How many drms may be down during a voluntary disruption. A number or a percentage.

replicaCount.description: Number of drms compute nodes. Each registers itself with task. 0 deploys the core services only.

resources.description: Resources of each drms. A run uses every core it can get: Sigma2 gives each 16 CPU and 64 GiB.

spreadAcrossNodes.description: Prefer one drms per node (a soft topology spread constraint on the hostname).

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Seconds a drms gets to unregister from task after SIGTERM. A drms killed before that stays in task's queue until task restarts.

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Extra topology spread constraints for drms pods.

fullnameOverride.description: Overrides the full resource name prefix. Keep it under 40 characters.

global.description: Global values shared between all subcharts
global.$comment: Added automatically by 'helm schema' to allow this chart to be used as a Helm dependency, as this schema would otherwise not allow Helm's special 'global' values key.

digest.description: Optional image digest (`sha256:…`). When set, the image is pulled by digest and the tag is informational.

repository.description: Shyft image repository. Sigma2 can only pull from its own registry: mirror the image and set this.

tag.description: Shyft image tag. Empty: the chart's `appVersion`, the image it was tested with. Set it only to run another build of the same Shyft line.

imagePullSecrets.description: Pull secrets for the image, as a list of `{name: …}`.

nameOverride.description: Overrides the chart name in resource names and labels.

allowNamespace.description: Let every pod in the release namespace connect to the core services.

clientPeers.description: Who else may connect to the core services, as NetworkPolicy peers: a `podSelector`, a `namespaceSelector`, or with a load balancer an `ipBlock` for your client network.

enabled.description: Create NetworkPolicies: core accepts drms, the chart's test pods and the clients below; drms accepts only core. They need a CNI that enforces NetworkPolicy.
Mount an existing claim with input data into the core containers.

existingClaim.description: The claim to mount. Required when enabled; the chart never creates it.

mountInDrms.description: Also mount it into drms pods. With more than one node this needs a ReadWriteMany (or ReadOnlyMany) claim.

accessModes.description: Access modes of the created claim.

enabled.description: Keep the service databases on a PersistentVolume. `false` uses an emptyDir: data is lost with the pod.

existingClaim.description: Use this existing claim instead of creating one. It must allow writes from the core pod's user.

size.description: Size of the created claim. It cannot be changed through the chart later.

storageClass.description: Storage class of the created claim. Empty uses the cluster default.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod security context of every pod. uid and gid 1000 are user `ci` in the Shyft image. On storage that ignores `fsGroup` (NFS), set the uid and gid that own the directory.

failureThreshold.description: Liveness probes that may fail before the container is restarted.
Readiness probes that may fail before the pod is taken out of the Service.
Startup probes that may fail before the container is restarted. With the period: 2 minutes to start.

securityContext.description: Container security context of every container. The root filesystem is read-only; /tmp is an emptyDir.

annotations.description: Service annotations, for example the cloud's internal load balancer annotation.

cloud.description: With `type: LoadBalancer`: the cloud the cluster runs in. The chart then requires that cloud's internal load balancer annotation in `annotations`: another cloud's annotation does nothing there, and the load balancer would be public.

type.description: Service type for the core services. `LoadBalancer` is rendered only with an annotation that makes it internal: Shyft's protocol has no authentication.

create.description: Create a ServiceAccount. The pods never talk to the Kubernetes API and mount no token.

name.description: Name of the ServiceAccount. Empty uses the release's full name, or `default` when `create` is false.

basePort.description: Base port. Each service listens on `basePort + 2·n`: task 0, rmd 1, parameter 2, state 3, drms 4, dtss 5, dstm 6, stm 7, goal_function 8. The offsets are fixed by Shyft.

enabled.description: Add a `helm test` that seeds Shyft's demo model and runs it on a drms. It writes demo data into the databases, so it is off by default: use it in CI and on a fresh install. Needs at least one drms.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector for the `helm test` pods. They run the Shyft image, so on a cluster with arm64 nodes they need `kubernetes.io/arch: amd64` like the workloads do.
